text:
alicia: FYI nightly evals started spiking on the int8 candidate; lots of timeouts on prompt set 4. Investigating.

ben: seeing same in dashboards, ~40% timeouts. 503 from harness workers, not OOM.

carmen: did anything touch the workqueue recently? we had that rebalancer PR last week.

diego: I reverted the rebalancer on prod yesterday but nightly infra still had the harness-scheduler patch merged. link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/harness/pull/432

alicia: repro steps i'm using:```./run_eval --model model-v2-int8 --prompts=prompts/suite4.json --seed=42 --parallel=8```hangs after ~40s. stack shows worker stuck in workqueue.pop() waiting on cond.

ci-bot: CI: nightly-evals/2150012345 failed 8 tests — https://ci.internal/builds/9081 (failure type: timeout) :warning:

ellie: i can repro locally with parallel=4. nondet: sometimes passes, sometimes hangs. i think the queue priority reshuffle (runs every 30s) can run mid-epoch and reorder pending jobs, exposing a contention window. :thinking:

ben: logs snippet from a hanging run:```goroutine 132 [semacquire]:
sync.runtime_SemacquireMutex(0xc0001a0f10, 0x1)
	/usr/local/go/src/runtime/sema.go:71 +0x45
github.com/redwood/inference/harness/workqueue.(*Queue).pop(0xc0001a0e00, 0x0)
	/home/runner/work/harness/workqueue/queue.go:214 +0x2a1
main.(*worker).run(0xc0002a4000)
	/home/runner/work/harness/worker/worker.go:89 +0x13f
```

carmen: can you try disabling shuffle? set env `WORKQ_SHUFFLE=false` and re-run.

alicia: tried that — reduced hangs but still saw 2/5 runs hang. stack changed: now blockers show tokenizer lock in `tokenizer.normalizer` -> suggests ordering change matters for tokenizer locking.

diego: ah — we added dynamic run salt to diversify random seeds across machines: env var `EVAL_RUN_SEED_SALT` default is now `dynamic` which mixes epoch time. that could change job ordering and timings.

alicia: nice catch. when i set `EVAL_RUN_SEED_SALT=static` the local flakiness disappeared (ran 10/10 stable). looks promising.

ellie: i'll prepare a tiny PR to default the harness to `static` in CI until we sort the race, and add a unit test asserting queue ordering deterministic given fixed salt. i'll also add a test for the shuffle not running mid-epoch.

alicia: action items: 1) ellie PR to default salt and tests, 2) diego open incident ticket for the scheduler rebalancer visibility, 3) ben add fast watchdog to fail and dump goroutine stacks at 30s, 4) qa-bot re-run 5 attempts for verification. i'll attach logs to the incident.

qa-bot: re-run started: 5 attempts queued (seed varying).

qa-bot: re-run results: with EVAL_RUN_SEED_SALT=static => 5/5 passed; with dynamic salt => 2/5 hung (matches local).

alicia: summary: root cause appears to be interaction between dynamic run salt (changes job ordering/timing) and the workqueue shuffle/scheduler exposing a tokenizer lock ordering race. Mitigation: revert dynamic salt (make static default), add watchdog and deterministic-order tests, and bisect scheduler changes next to find minimal repro. reopening if flake returns. :thumbsup:

ellie: will send PR in ~30m.

diego: filing incident and starting a bisect now.

ben: i'll land watchdog branch behind feature flag.

alicia: thanks all — keeping this thread pinned until PRs merged.
